text:
Maya: ok, this is ridiculous — quick life update: I shoved a tiny bath towel in a shoebox and Nimbus (my pygmy hedgehog) immediately claimed it as a yacht. photo incoming :camera_with_flash:

Owen: pls drop the pic :pleading_face: I need it for my morale

Maya: https://cdn.redwood-internal/pets/nimbus-yacht.jpg (tiny hedgehog peeking out, curled into a perfect donut) :teacup:

Raul: omg :scream: he is a loaf and also a captain. how is that not a hazard, @Katie? (asking officially as hedgehog safety officer)

Katie: looks safe to me. sand-safe towel, no loose threads, no heat lamps nearby — 10/10 would adopt. also someone made a hedgehog sticker pack for slack :hedgehog:

Owen: hedgehog sticker pack = instant productivity boost. can we make Hedgehog Friday a thing? vote: +1 from me

Maya: signing us up. Nimbus has strict nap schedules so Fridays work. also he demands snacks. feeding advice? i gave a couple mealworms and he seemed thrilled.

Raul: freeze-dried crickets are solid. avoid honey and too much fruit. DM me your address and i'll mail some safe treats.

Maya: legend, thank you! :heart: adding 'Nimbus yacht check-in' to my calendar as a recurring meeting.
